arabic text: SADQA HO SAKINA KA ATA HAZRAT E ABBAS
english translation text: O Abbas, prayer of Fatima Zahra, grant us the charity of Sakina.

arabic text: UMEED E HARAM DIL KI SADA HAZRAT E ABBAS\nSADQA HO SAKINA KA ATA HAZRAT E ABBAS
english translation text: Hope of the sanctuary and cry of the heart—O Abbas,\ngrant us the charity of Sakina.

arabic text: TUM ZAINAB O KULSOOM KI DHARAS HO PATA HAI\nHAR BHAYI KE HONTO PA YEHI EK DUA HAI\nBEHNO KE RAHE SAR PA RIDA HAZRAT E ABBAS
english translation text: You are the support of Zainab and Kulsum; everyone knows this.\nOnly one prayer remains upon every brother's lips:\nmay a veil remain upon every sister's head, O Abbas.

arabic text: JANNAT KI TAMANNA HI NAHI DIL ME HUMARE\nPHIR KYUN NA YEH MAJLIS ME AZADAR PUKARE\nAANA HAI MUJHE KARBOBALA HAZRAT E ABBAS
english translation text: We hold no desire even for Paradise.\nWhy should the mourners not call out in the majlis:\nI wish to come to Karbala, O Abbas.

arabic text: AISI HAI CHACHA AUR BHATEEJI ME MOHABBAT\nABBAS CHALE AATE HAIN KHUD KARNE INAYAT\nJISNE BHI YEH IK BAAR KAHAA HAZRAT ABBAS
english translation text: Such is the love between the uncle and niece\nthat Abbas himself comes to bestow grace\nupon whoever calls his name even once.

arabic text: AB KHATM JUDAI HO MILE BEHNO SE BHAAYI\nBE JURM ASEERO KO MILE JALD RIHAAYI\nAPNO SE NA APNE HO JUDA HAZRAT E ABBAS
english translation text: May separation end and brothers reunite with sisters.\nMay innocent captives soon receive freedom.\nMay loved ones never be separated, O Abbas.

arabic text: BAS CHALTI RAHEIN AAPKE PARCHAM KI HAWAAEIN\nMIT JAAEIN ZAMANE SE MUKAMMAL YEH WABAAEIN\nMILJAAEI MAREEZON KO SHIFA HAZRAT E ABBAS
english translation text: May the breeze of your standard continue to blow.\nMay every epidemic disappear completely from the world.\nMay the sick receive healing, O Abbas.

arabic text: MUSHKIL ME SADA AAPKO DETA HON LABON SE\nMOLA ME PARESHAN HON DUNYA KE GHAMON SE\nDIL GHAM SE NA PHAT JAAE MERA HAZRAT E ABBAS
english translation text: In hardship I always call you with my lips.\nMaula, I am troubled by the world's grief.\nDo not let my heart split from sorrow, O Abbas.

arabic text: DUNYAWI SHEHNSHAHON SE BARHKAR HI RAHENGE\nZEESHAN O KARIM AAPKE NOKAR HI RAHENGE\nDE DIJIYE KHIDMAT KA SILA HAZRAT E ABBAS
english translation text: We will remain above worldly kings,\nfor Zeeshan and Karim will always remain your servants.\nGrant us the reward of service, O Abbas.
